payload.title: Shipped keeps a different product shape on a dedicated deployment
payload.description:
What: record what Shipped keeps as its own product on a dedicated deployment (Papyrus decision: our own sites stay dedicated for now): the signal and map surfaces (task-group columns, size bands, licence markers in web/map-view.json), periodic table, Underrated, Nearby, Vapor log, sponsorship, newsletter lists, and its scoring verdicts. These are hooks kept as tracked gaps; each gets a Papyrus promotion issue only if a second site wants it. Shipped does not bend the core catalogue around them.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Every remaining Shipped hook is listed
  Given the hooks after the block swaps
  Then each is marked product-specific or promote-to-core, with an issue for the latter
